verdict.rationale: Square documents its own catalog and inventory capabilities: a Catalog API ('Design a Catalog'), an Inventory API, 'Track inventory' on the merchant site, and llms.txt describing APIs for 'managing catalogs, running storefronts'. Multi-location support exists via the Locations API. However, the evidence is mostly page titles, and nothing explicitly shows inventory counts staying in sync across registers and channels. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of real-time cross-register/cross-channel inventory sync, detail beyond doc titles on catalog and inventory management, independent or hands-on corroboration.
